supernatural.Intro: the 'Back of My Mind' sample hits and ad-libs (two per bar); no drums yet
supernatural.Groove: NJS drum kit: kick on 1, syncopated kick on 2&, clap on the backbeat
supernatural.Verse 1: same drum figure as the Groove, so the verse can be learned from the groove; vocal phrases sit on top without taps of their own
supernatural.Pre-chorus 1: kick + clap, with 8th pairs on beats 3–4; the snare roll into the chorus becomes an 8-tap 8th run
supernatural.Chorus 1: kick + clap backbeat, with 8th runs on beats 3–4 (the hook drum figure)
supernatural.Bridge: sparse kick hits under the held vocals; long glides; the bar-51 snare fill re-enters as an 8th run
supernatural.Chorus 2: same tap pattern as Chorus 1 (unified bar for bar where audible)
supernatural.Final chorus: Chorus-1 pattern again, densest because the drums are fullest

how-sweet.Intro: the synth-bass/melody stabs of the intro (one per bar)
how-sweet.Verse 1: kick pattern + clap; ends with a full-mix 16th hat/snare fill into the pre-chorus
how-sweet.Pre-chorus 1: kick on the beat, clap answer; a 16th fill on the last beat into the chorus
how-sweet.Chorus 2: Chorus-1 pattern (shared bar for bar where audible)
how-sweet.Bridge: half-density clap/kick; 16th fill at the end into the build
how-sweet.Build: kick + clap, rising; one 16th fill at the 4-bar phrase end

bubble-gum.Intro: melodic plucks of the intro (melodic layer)
bubble-gum.Pre-chorus 1: kick + clap, 8th pairs at phrase ends
bubble-gum.Breakdown: vocal phrases over the drop-out (vocal layer); sparse

right-now.Verse 1: kick + clap pattern on the 8th grid (172 BPM)
